Well, I've been farming these 9.5 mu for 40 years now. Me and my wife, we're both getting on — I'm 65, she's not much younger. We only finished primary school, but I know this land better than any book. We don't have much cash to spare, so I have to watch every yuan. I learned most of what I know from my father and from watching what works on my own fields and what my neighbors do.

Right now it's late April. The winter wheat I planted last October on the 7 mu is coming up nicely. I put down base fertilizer before planting — about 50 kg of compound fertilizer per mu — and now I'm deciding on the topdress. The wheat looks a bit yellow in spots, so I'll spread another 15 kg of urea per mu at jointing this week. My neighbor Lao Wang uses more, but I don't have extra cash and last year I got about 400 kg per mu, which is good enough for us. I'll irrigate three times total — one at jointing now, one at grain filling in May, and I did one earlier this spring when it was dry. The pump electricity costs money, so three times is all I can afford. I'll spray herbicide once if the weeds come up. Me and the wife can handle most of the work, but I might hire two days of help at harvest.

Cotton — I'm planting it right now on the 2.5 mu plot down by the well. Using the same improved seed as last year, about 40 yuan per mu. I'll put compound fertilizer in the furrow at planting, about 25 kg per mu, and topdress with 10 kg of urea when it flowers in July. Cotton needs watching for bollworm, so I'll spray insecticide twice and herbicide once. I'll irrigate twice, maybe three times if it's a dry summer like two years ago. Me and the wife will pick it ourselves through September and October. I hope for about 220 kg of lint per mu.

After we harvest the wheat in early June — around June 8th, if the weather holds — I only have a few days to get the maize in before the season closes. I'll hire the rotary tiller guy to quickly prepare the field, then plant hybrid maize seed. Seed costs about 50 yuan per mu. I put down 30 kg of compound fertilizer at planting and topdress with 15 kg of urea when the plants are knee-high in July. Two irrigations should do it if the rain cooperates. I expect about 420 kg per mu.

Total spending this year — seed, fertilizer, pesticide, pump electricity, a little hired help for harvest and tillage — I'm looking at about 5,200 yuan. That's a big chunk of what we have, but we need to spend it to eat. I don't like changing what works. Last year was okay, not great, not terrible. I'll do about the same.
